europe_now.title: Poland plans eastern border no-fly zone
europe_now.summary: Poland has announced plans to establish a no-fly zone along its eastern border to assist in intercepting and downing Russian missiles following repeated airspace violations. The security measure aims to enhance defense capabilities in the region amid ongoing cross-border threats.

europe_now.title: European Union rejects new United States tariffs
europe_now.summary: The European Union has strongly rejected the premise of newly proposed United States trade tariffs targeting major partners including Europe and China. European officials and trade experts have raised concerns over escalating transatlantic economic tensions.

top_stories.title: EU budget and funding negotiations
top_stories.summary: European leaders face significant friction and divergent priorities during ongoing negotiations over the upcoming seven-year EU budget. French President Emmanuel Macron has threatened to halt discussions on the financial package after December if an agreement is not reached.
